$comment: Tablet action inputs (docs/contracts.md §C12, §C13, §C14, §C15, §C16). Valid samples carry the cleaned value zod returns, invalid samples the reason. Checked against the zod schemas by resources/[fredpd]/fredpd_mdt/test/validate.test.ts and against fredpd_mdt/shared/validate.lua by tests/lua/mdt_validate_test.lua. actions.<name>.grant is the grant column of MDT_ACTIONS / DISPATCH_ACTIONS / EVIDENCE_ACTIONS / RECORDS_ACTIONS / INTEL_ACTIONS, mirrored by fredpd_mdt/server/dispatch.lua. One SearchInput page is written as 3.0 on purpose (a float in Lua). String lengths are Unicode code points (zod 4.6), so an emoji counts 1. Samples never use null (Lua reads it as an absent field) or [] (Lua reads it as {}).

invalid.why: lines must be an array (empty object)
